''See also: [[Bloodspawn Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Bloodspawn are creatures of blood and [[madra]] created by the [[Bleeding Phoenix]]. They emerge from spilled blood once it has left a host's body and spirit, meaning they cannot form while the liquid is still under an individual's control. These entities act as puppets or parodies of living beings, often taking on crude, shifting shapes such as gnarled trees, gas clouds, jagged crystals, or humanoid figures. Some can even mimic the [[madra]] of those they consume, appearing as blocky clay men or advanced warriors wielding weapons. These creatures serve several roles within [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]]'s influence. They can act as hunters that roam in packs, or they can sacrifice themselves to kill [[sacred artists]] by latching onto them and transforming into strangling crimson vines. They are capable of rapid reproduction; every new wound that spills blood can result in the birth of another spawn. As the [[Dreadgod]] awakens, the threat posed by these creatures increases, potentially turning every drop of blood within a hundred-mile radius into a monster. While they are considered lesser creations compared to other manifestations of [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]], they can form massive armies that pose a significant regional emergency.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Some of these creatures possess bodies that seem to contain a wooden skeleton, while others feature limbs made of flourishing tree branches. They can also take on human-like shapes equipped with swords.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|These creatures are characterized by a malicious [[hunger]]. They roam in packs to hunt resistance and have the capacity to ruin towns or tear apart refugees.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Mercy]] and [[Renfei]] engaged in combat against the bloodspawn. Additionally, [[Orthos]] acts as a force that eliminates these creatures.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Composed of [[madra]], these entities can explode into scarlet leaves and crimson vines or burst into thorns when approached. They are capable of performing suicide attacks upon death.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Biological Properties}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Bloodspawn are creatures that can be created from human injuries, with some individuals possessing bodies that appear to contain a wooden skeleton.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9">''Skysworn'', chapter 9</ref> Certain specimens are known to explode into branches of crimson vines adorned with scarlet leaves.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9" /> Hundreds of these entities exist at ground level and possess the capability to ruin entire towns.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c11">''Skysworn'', chapter 11</ref> Originating from a [[Dreadgod]], these creatures are part of [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]]'s power and hatch from blood when the [[Dreadgod]] wakes.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c11" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c12">''Skysworn'', chapter 12</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|some [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]] have bodies that appear to have a skeleton of wood underneath.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|certain [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]] explode into branches of crimson vines covered in scarlet leaves.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|There are hundreds of [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]] at ground level.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9" />}}</li>
